<\STATESEP>chapter "Virtual-Memory Rights"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory VMRights_A
imports CapRights_A
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym vm_rights = cap_rights<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition vm_kernel_only :: vm_rights
where
  "vm_kernel_only \<equiv> {}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition vm_read_only :: vm_rights
where
  "vm_read_only \<equiv> {AllowRead}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition vm_read_write :: vm_rights
where
  "vm_read_write \<equiv> {AllowRead,AllowWrite}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition valid_vm_rights :: "vm_rights set"
where
  "valid_vm_rights \<equiv> {vm_read_write, vm_read_only, vm_kernel_only}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition validate_vm_rights :: "vm_rights \<Rightarrow> vm_rights"
where
  "validate_vm_rights rs \<equiv>
     if AllowRead \<in> rs
     then if AllowWrite \<in> rs then vm_read_write else vm_read_only
     else vm_kernel_only"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition mask_vm_rights :: "vm_rights \<Rightarrow> cap_rights \<Rightarrow> vm_rights"
where
  "mask_vm_rights V R \<equiv> validate_vm_rights (V \<inter> R)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
